s: In line with the Fourth Industrial Revolution push, which version of its Industry Policy does Andhra Pradesh have?
x: Andhra Pradesh has an Industry Policy 4.0 (the Industrial Development Policy 4.0, 2024-29), matching the Industry 4.0 / Fourth Industrial Revolution theme; the WEF is also setting up a Fourth Industrial Revolution Centre in the State.
why: 24 Apr 2026 in the notes is the news-source date, not the date the policy was notified; the notes elsewhere date AP Industrial Development Policy 4.0 to 2024-29, so the keyed date is unsupported and likely wrong. Re-asked on the policy version instead.
